name: Test fit a floor
about: Lays out a workplace floor from its programme: the rooms asked for along the sides of the floor, the open office filled with desks until everyone has a seat, every room furnished and given a door. It offers a few layouts ranked by how well each meets the programme, and draws the one you pick. The floor is an empty shell already drawn: its outer walls, the core's rooms and the entrance door.
useWhen: The owner has an empty office floor drawn (outer walls, core, entrance) and a programme (how many people, which rooms), and wants a first furnished layout to react to.

input.about: Nothing: it reads the project's drawing and its programme. Optional params: top (how many layouts to offer, 1 to 6), people (when the programme gives no headcount).

rules.text: Work in whole millimetres on the project's plan axes, on the project's planning module (1.5 m unless the project says otherwise).
The floor to fit out is the largest room of the level; the other rooms drawn on it are the core and stay as they are. A door in the outer wall is the entrance.
The programme decides: its people are seated and its rooms placed before anything else is added; the typology's ratios add only what the programme left short.
Nothing is drawn until the owner picks a layout: the pick is one logged, undoable step.

steps.name: Lay out the floor
steps.outcome: A few layouts of the floor that meet the programme, the best first.

steps.name: Pick the layout
steps.question: Which layout should be drawn? Click it on the plan or pick it here.

output.name: Test fit
output.about: The layout picked: its rooms, seats and furniture drawn on the floor.
